title: ATTP and the prevention of manipulation in sport
excerpt: Unprecedented results in a global fight
body_html:
Table tennis, like sport in general, brings out the best qualities in each of us, and fair play is a fundamental, integral part of every sporting event — not only in the Republic of Moldova but around the world.

However, the joy and satisfaction that sport brings people can easily be overshadowed by fraud such as match-fixing and result manipulation.

Corruption in sport undermines trust in competition results and damages the reputation of the sport, its athletes and the country.

This obliges all of us who care about the future of table tennis in Moldova to give it the protection it needs, so that we can keep popularising it and use it as one of the ways to educate future generations.

Thanks to our efforts and ongoing cooperation with the relevant institutions and partner organisations, in about 2 years we have achieved unprecedented results in a truly global fight to prevent and counter match-fixing and result manipulation in table tennis in the Republic of Moldova. We already see our methodology and good practices being applied productively at sports venues in other countries.

ATTP is at the start of the road and hopes that every table tennis fan will join our team and the fair play concept we promote.
